firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently picked a mushroom starts. Turns proceed clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: For later rounds, the player to the left of whoever announced the previous round's end starts the new round.
